description: This is a shell script that implements the setup, teardown, and initialization routines for the 464xlat CLAT protocol in an OpenWrt environment. It manages network configurations, routing rules, and firewall settings related to IPv6 translation.

methods.name: proto_464xlat_setup
methods.description: Sets up the 464xlat IPv6 translation environment, including routing rules and firewall configuration.

methods.name: proto_464xlat_teardown
methods.description: Removes the configuration and rules set up by the setup function, cleaning up network state.

methods.name: proto_464xlat_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the configuration parameters for 464xlat, preparing for setup based on user inputs.
